verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֙פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵה֖וּד מֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh wə·’ê·hūḏ mêṯ
verses.literal: After Ehud died the Israelites . . . again did evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Israel tornaram a fazer o mal à vista de Jeová, depois da morte de Eúde.

verses.original: וַיִּמְכְּרֵ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה בְּיַד֙ יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחָצ֑וֹר וְשַׂר־ צְבָאוֹ֙ סִֽיסְרָ֔א וְה֥וּא יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בַּחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·kə·rêm Yah·weh bə·yaḏ yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- kə·na·‘an ’ă·šer mā·laḵ bə·ḥā·ṣō·wr wə·śar- ṣə·ḇā·’ōw sî·sə·rā wə·hū yō·wō·šêḇ ba·ḥă·rō·šeṯ hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: So the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan who reigned in Hazor The commander of his forces was Sisera who lived in Harosheth-hagoyim . . .
verses.literalPt: Entregou-os Jeová nas mãos de Jabim, rei de Canaã, que reinou em Hazor; o general do seu exército era Sísera, que habitava em Harosete dos Gentios.

verses.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֠י תְּשַׁ֨ע מֵא֤וֹת רֶֽכֶב־ בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔וֹ וְ֠הוּא לָחַ֞ץ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בְּחָזְקָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- Yah·weh kî tə·ša‘ mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ- bar·zel lōw wə·hū lā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·ḥā·zə·qāh ‘eś·rîm šā·nāh
verses.literal: Then the Israelites . . . cried out to the LORD because Jabin had nine hundred chariots of iron and he had harshly oppressed the Israelites . . . for twenty years
verses.literalPt: Clamaram os filhos de Israel a Jeová, porque Jabim tinha novecentos carros de ferro e, por vinte anos, oprimia cruelmente os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וּדְבוֹרָה֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה נְבִיאָ֔ה אֵ֖שֶׁת לַפִּיד֑וֹת הִ֛יא שֹׁפְטָ֥ה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḏə·ḇō·w·rāh ’iš·šāh nə·ḇî·’āh ’ê·šeṯ lap·pî·ḏō·wṯ hî šō·p̄ə·ṭāh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bā·‘êṯ ha·hî
verses.literal: Now Deborah a prophetess the wife of Lappidoth was judging Israel at that time . . .
verses.literalPt: Débora, profetisa, mulher de Lapidote, julgava a Israel naquele tempo.

verses.original: וְ֠הִיא יוֹשֶׁ֨בֶת תַּֽחַת־ תֹּ֜מֶר דְּבוֹרָ֗ה בֵּ֧ין הָרָמָ֛ה וּבֵ֥ין בֵּֽית־ אֵ֖ל בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֵלֶ֛יהָ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hî yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ta·ḥaṯ- tō·mer də·ḇō·w·rāh bên hā·rā·māh ū·ḇên bêṯ- ’êl bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim way·ya·‘ă·lū ’ê·le·hā bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lam·miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: And she would sit under the Palm of Deborah between Ramah . . . and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim where the Israelites . . . would go up to her for judgment
verses.literalPt: Ela se assentava debaixo da palmeira de Débora, entre Ramá e Betel, na região montanhosa de Efraim; e os filhos de Israel subiam a ter com ela a juízo.

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַתִּקְרָא֙ לְבָרָ֣ק בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹ֔עַם מִקֶּ֖דֶשׁ נַפְתָּלִ֑י וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו הֲלֹ֥א צִוָּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לֵ֤ךְ וּמָֽשַׁכְתָּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ עִמְּךָ֗ עֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ אִ֔ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִ֖י וּמִבְּנֵ֥י זְבֻלֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·laḥ wat·tiq·rā lə·ḇā·rāq ben- ’ă·ḇî·nō·‘am miq·qe·ḏeš nap̄·tā·lî wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw hă·lō ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl lêḵ ū·mā·šaḵ·tā bə·har tā·ḇō·wr wə·lā·qaḥ·tā ‘im·mə·ḵā ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš mib·bə·nê nap̄·tā·lî ū·mib·bə·nê zə·ḇu·lūn
verses.literal: She summoned . . . Barak son of Abinoam from Kedesh in Naphtali and said to him Surely the LORD the God of Israel is commanding you Go and march to Mount Tabor taking with you ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun
verses.literalPt: Esta mandou chamar a Baraque, filho de Abinoão, de Quedes-Naftali, e lhe disse: Não te ordena Jeová, Deus de Israel: Vai, e marcha para o monte Tabor, e leva contigo dez mil homens dos filhos de Naftali e dos filhos de Zebulom?

verses.original: וּמָשַׁכְתִּ֨י אֵלֶ֜יךָ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל קִישׁ֗וֹן אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֙ שַׂר־ צְבָ֣א יָבִ֔ין וְאֶת־ רִכְבּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ הֲמוֹנ֑וֹ וּנְתַתִּ֖יהוּ בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·šaḵ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā ’el- na·ḥal qî·šō·wn ’eṯ- sî·sə·rā śar- ṣə·ḇā yā·ḇîn wə·’eṯ- riḵ·bōw wə·’eṯ- hă·mō·w·nōw ū·nə·ṯat·tî·hū bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: And I will draw out Sisera the commander of Jabin’s army his chariots and his troops to the River Kishon and I will deliver him into your hand
verses.literalPt: Atrairei a ti ao rio Quisom Sísera, general das hostes de Jabim, juntamente com os seus carros e com as suas tropas, e to entregarei nas mãos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ בָּרָ֔ק אִם־ תֵּלְכִ֥י עִמִּ֖י וְהָלָ֑כְתִּי וְאִם־ לֹ֥א תֵלְכִ֛י עִמִּ֖י לֹ֥א אֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā bā·rāq ’im- tê·lə·ḵî ‘im·mî wə·hā·lā·ḵə·tî wə·’im- lō ṯê·lə·ḵî ‘im·mî lō ’ê·lêḵ
verses.literal: Barak said to her If you will go with me I will go but if you will not go with me I will not go
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Baraque: Se vieres comigo, irei; mas, se não vieres comigo, não irei.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֜אמֶר הָלֹ֧ךְ אֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗ךְ אֶ֚פֶס כִּי֩ לֹ֨א תִֽהְיֶ֜ה תִּֽפְאַרְתְּךָ֗ עַל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתָּ֣ה הוֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י בְֽיַד־ אִשָּׁ֔ה יִמְכֹּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָ֑א וַתָּ֧קָם דְּבוֹרָ֛ה וַתֵּ֥לֶך עִם־ בָּרָ֖ק קֶֽדְשָׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer hā·lōḵ ’ê·lêḵ ‘im·māḵ ’e·p̄es kî lō ṯih·yeh tip̄·’ar·tə·ḵā ‘al- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh hō·w·lêḵ kî ḇə·yaḏ- ’iš·šāh yim·kōr Yah·weh ’eṯ- sî·sə·rā wat·tā·qām də·ḇō·w·rāh wat·tē·lɛḵ ‘im- bā·rāq qeḏ·šāh
verses.literal: I will certainly go . . . with you Deborah replied but . . . the road you are taking will bring you no honor because the LORD will be selling Sisera into the hand of a woman So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh
verses.literalPt: Respondeu ela: Certamente irei contigo. Contudo, não será tua a glória na expedição em que vais; porque Jeová entregará a Sísera nas mãos duma mulher. Levantou-se Débora e foi com Baraque a Quedes.

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֨ק בָּרָ֜ק אֶת־ זְבוּלֻ֤ן וְאֶת־ נַפְתָּלִי֙ קֶ֔דְשָׁה וַיַּ֣עַל בְּרַגְלָ֔יו עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אַלְפֵ֖י אִ֑ישׁ וַתַּ֥עַל עִמּ֖וֹ דְּבוֹרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaz·‘êq bā·rāq ’eṯ- zə·ḇū·lun wə·’eṯ- nap̄·tā·lî qeḏ·šāh way·ya·‘al bə·raḡ·lāw ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’al·p̄ê ’îš wat·ta·‘al ‘im·mōw də·ḇō·w·rāh
verses.literal: where he summoned Zebulun and Naphtali Ten thousand men followed him and Deborah also went with him
verses.literalPt: Baraque convocou a Zebulom e a Naftali em Quedes; subiram dez mil homens após ele; também Débora subiu com ele.

verses.original: וְחֶ֤בֶר הַקֵּינִי֙ נִפְרָ֣ד מִקַּ֔יִן מִבְּנֵ֥י חֹבָ֖ב חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֵּ֣ט אָהֳל֔וֹ עַד־ אֵל֥וֹן בַּצְעַנִּים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶת־ קֶֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥe·ḇer haq·qê·nî nip̄·rāḏ miq·qa·yin mib·bə·nê ḥō·ḇāḇ ḥō·ṯên mō·šeh way·yêṭ ’ā·ho·lōw ‘aḏ- ’ê·lō·wn baṣ·ʿan·nīm ’ă·šer ’eṯ- qe·ḏeš
verses.literal: Now Heber the Kenite had moved away from the Kenites the descendants of Hobab the father-in-law of Moses and had pitched his tent by the great tree of Zaanannim which was near Kedesh
verses.literalPt: Ora, Héber, queneu, se tinha separado dos queneus, a saber, dos filhos de Hobabe, sogro de Moisés, e tinha armado as suas tendas até chegar ao terebinto em Zaanim, que está junto a Quedes.

verses.original: וַיַּגִּ֖דוּ לְסִֽיסְרָ֑א כִּ֥י עָלָ֛ה בָּרָ֥ק בֶּן־ אֲבִינֹ֖עַם הַר־ תָּבֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yag·gi·ḏū lə·sî·sə·rā kî ‘ā·lāh bā·rāq ben- ’ă·ḇî·nō·‘am har- tā·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: When Sisera was told that Barak son of Abinoam had gone up Mount Tabor
verses.literalPt: Anunciaram a Sísera que Baraque, filho de Abinoão, tinha subido ao monte Tabor.

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֨ק סִֽיסְרָ֜א אֶת־ כָּל־ רִכְבּ֗וֹ תְּשַׁ֤ע מֵאוֹת֙ רֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ מֵחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶל־ נַ֥חַל קִישֽׁוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaz·‘êq sî·sə·rā ’eṯ- kāl- riḵ·bōw tə·ša‘ mê·’ō·wṯ re·ḵeḇ bar·zel wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer ’it·tōw mê·ḥă·rō·šeṯ hag·gō·w·yim ’el- na·ḥal qî·šō·wn
verses.literal: he summoned all nine hundred of his iron chariots and all the men with him from Harosheth-hagoyim . . . to the River Kishon
verses.literalPt: Sísera ajuntou todos os seus carros, novecentos carros de ferro, e todo o povo que estava com ele, desde Harosete dos Gentios até o rio Quisom.

verses.original: וַתֹּאמֶר֩ דְּבֹרָ֨ה אֶל־ בָּרָ֜ק ק֗וּם כִּ֣י זֶ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֤ה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ הֲלֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה יָצָ֣א לְפָנֶ֑יךָ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בָּרָק֙ מֵהַ֣ר תָּב֔וֹר וַעֲשֶׂ֧רֶת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֖ישׁ אַחֲרָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer də·ḇō·rāh ’el- bā·rāq qūm kî zeh hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’eṯ- sî·sə·rā bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā hă·lō Yah·weh yā·ṣā lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā way·yê·reḏ bā·rāq mê·har tā·ḇō·wr wa·‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ’îš ’a·ḥă·rāw
verses.literal: Then Deborah said to Barak Arise for this is the day that the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand Has not the LORD gone before you So Barak came down from Mount Tabor with ten thousand men following him
verses.literalPt: Disse Débora a Baraque: Levanta-te, porque este é o dia em que Jeová entregou nas tuas mãos a Sísera; não saiu Jeová diante de ti? Desceu Baraque do monte Tabor e dez mil homens após ele.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣הָם יְ֠הוָה אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָ֨א וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֧כֶב וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֛ה לְפִי־ חֶ֖רֶב לִפְנֵ֣י בָרָ֑ק וַיֵּ֧רֶד סִֽיסְרָ֛א מֵעַ֥ל הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֖ה וַיָּ֥נָס בְּרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·hām Yah·weh ’eṯ- sî·sə·rā wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma·ḥă·neh lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ lip̄·nê ḇā·rāq way·yê·reḏ sî·sə·rā mê·‘al ham·mer·kā·ḇāh way·yā·nās bə·raḡ·lāw
verses.literal: And in front of him the LORD routed with the sword Sisera all his charioteers and all his army Sisera abandoned . . . his chariot and fled on foot
verses.literalPt: Diante de Baraque Jeová desbaratou ao fio da espada a Sísera com todos os seus carros e todas as suas hostes; Sísera desceu do seu carro e fugiu a pé.

verses.original: וּבָרָ֗ק רָדַ֞ף אַחֲרֵ֤י הָרֶ֙כֶב֙ וְאַחֲרֵ֣י הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה עַ֖ד חֲרֹ֣שֶׁת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַיִּפֹּ֞ל כָּל־ מַחֲנֵ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ לְפִי־ חֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א נִשְׁאַ֖ר עַד־ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·rāq rā·ḏap̄ ’a·ḥă·rê hā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’a·ḥă·rê ham·ma·ḥă·neh ‘aḏ ḥă·rō·šeṯ hag·gō·w·yim way·yip·pōl kāl- ma·ḥă·nêh sî·sə·rā lə·p̄î- ḥe·reḇ lō niš·’ar ‘aḏ- ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: Then Barak pursued . . . the chariots . . . and army as far as Harosheth-hagoyim . . . and the whole army of Sisera . . . fell by the sword not a single man was left . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas Baraque perseguiu os carros e as hostes até Harosete dos Gentios. Todas as hostes de Sísera caíram ao fio da espada; não escapou nem sequer um só homem.

verses.original: וְסִֽיסְרָא֙ נָ֣ס בְּרַגְלָ֔יו אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל יָעֵ֔ל אֵ֖שֶּׁת חֶ֣בֶר הַקֵּינִ֑י כִּ֣י שָׁל֗וֹם בֵּ֚ין יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ חָצ֔וֹר וּבֵ֕ין בֵּ֖ית חֶ֥בֶר הַקֵּינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sî·sə·rā nās bə·raḡ·lāw ’el- ’ō·hel yā·‘êl ʾēš·šɛṯ ḥe·ḇer haq·qê·nî kî šā·lō·wm bên yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- ḥā·ṣō·wr ū·ḇên bêṯ ḥe·ḇer haq·qê·nî
verses.literal: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite
verses.literalPt: Entretanto, Sísera fugiu a pé à tenda da Jael, mulher de Héber, queneu, porque havia paz entre Jabim, rei de Hazor, e a casa de Héber, queneu.

verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֣א יָעֵל֮ לִקְרַ֣את סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו סוּרָ֧ה אֲדֹנִ֛י סוּרָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י אַל־ תִּירָ֑א וַיָּ֤סַר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ הָאֹ֔הֱלָה וַתְּכַסֵּ֖הוּ בַּשְּׂמִיכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·ṣê yā·‘êl liq·raṯ sî·sə·rā wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw sū·rāh ’ă·ḏō·nî sū·rāh ’ê·lay ’al- tî·rā way·yā·sar ’ê·le·hā hā·’ō·hĕ·lāh wat·tə·ḵas·sê·hū baś·śə·mî·ḵāh
verses.literal: Jael . . . went out to greet Sisera and said to him Come in my lord Come in with me Do not be afraid So he entered . . . her tent and she covered him with a blanket
verses.literalPt: Saindo Jael ao encontro de Sísera, disse-lhe: Entra, senhor meu, entra na minha tenda; não temas. Sísera entrou-lhe na tenda, e ela o cobriu com uma coberta.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר אֵלֶ֛יהָ הַשְׁקִינִי־ נָ֥א מְעַט־ מַ֖יִם כִּ֣י צָמֵ֑אתִי וַתִּפְתַּ֞ח אֶת־ נֹ֧אוד הֶחָלָ֛ב וַתַּשְׁקֵ֖הוּ וַתְּכַסֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā haš·qî·nî- nā mə·‘aṭ- ma·yim kî ṣā·mê·ṯî wat·tip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- nō·wḏ he·ḥā·lāḇ wat·taš·qê·hū wat·tə·ḵas·sê·hū
verses.literal: Sisera said to her Please give me a little water to drink for I am thirsty So she opened a container of milk gave him a drink and covered him again
verses.literalPt: Ele lhe disse: Dá-me de beber um pouco de água, porque estou com sede. Ela abriu um odre de leite, e lhe deu a beber, e o cobriu.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ עֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָאֹ֑הֶל וְהָיָה֩ אִם־ אִ֨ישׁ יָב֜וֹא וּשְׁאֵלֵ֗ךְ וְאָמַ֛ר הֲיֵֽשׁ־ פֹּ֥ה אִ֖ישׁ וְאָמַ֥רְתְּ אָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·le·hā ‘ă·mōḏ pe·ṯaḥ hā·’ō·hel wə·hā·yāh ’im- ’îš yā·ḇō·w ū·šə·’ê·lêḵ wə·’ā·mar hă·yêš- pōh ’îš wə·’ā·mart ’ā·yin
verses.literal: Stand at the entrance to the tent he said and if anyone comes and asks you Is there a man . . . here say No
verses.literalPt: Ele lhe disse mais: Põe-te à porta da tenda, e quando alguém vier e te perguntar: Está aqui alguém? responderás: Não.

verses.original: וַתִּקַּ֣ח יָעֵ֣ל אֵֽשֶׁת־ חֶ֠בֶר אֶת־ יְתַ֨ד הָאֹ֜הֶל וַתָּ֧שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמַּקֶּ֣בֶת בְּיָדָ֗הּ וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלָיו֙ בַּלָּ֔אט וַתִּתְקַ֤ע אֶת־ הַיָּתֵד֙ בְּרַקָּת֔וֹ וַתִּצְנַ֖ח בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהֽוּא־ נִרְדָּ֥ם וַיָּ֖עַף וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·qaḥ yā·‘êl ’ê·šeṯ- ḥe·ḇer ’eṯ- yə·ṯaḏ hā·’ō·hel wat·tā·śem ’eṯ- ham·maq·qe·ḇeṯ bə·yā·ḏāh wat·tā·ḇō·w ’ê·lāw bal·lāṭ wat·tiṯ·qa‘ ’eṯ- hay·yā·ṯêḏ bə·raq·qā·ṯōw wat·tiṣ·naḥ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·hū- nir·dām way·yā·‘ap̄ way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: But as he lay sleeping from exhaustion Heber’s wife Jael took a tent peg grabbed a hammer . . . and went silently to Sisera She drove the peg through his temple and into the ground and he died
verses.literalPt: Jael, mulher de Héber, tomou uma estaca da tenda e, levando um martelo na mão, chegou-se a ele mansamente e cravou-lhe a estaca na fonte, de sorte que penetrou na terra; pois estava num profundo sono e mui exausto. Assim morreu.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה בָרָק֮ רֹדֵ֣ף אֶת־ סִֽיסְרָא֒ וַתֵּצֵ֤א יָעֵל֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַתֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ לֵ֣ךְ וְאַרְאֶ֔ךָּ אֶת־ הָאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵלֶ֔יהָ וְהִנֵּ֤ה סִֽיסְרָא֙ נֹפֵ֣ל מֵ֔ת וְהַיָּתֵ֖ד בְּרַקָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḇā·rāq rō·ḏêp̄ ’eṯ- sî·sə·rā wat·tê·ṣê yā·‘êl liq·rā·ṯōw wat·tō·mer lōw lêḵ wə·’ar·’e·kā ’eṯ- hā·’îš ’ă·šer- ’at·tāh mə·ḇaq·qêš way·yā·ḇō ’ê·le·hā wə·hin·nêh sî·sə·rā nō·p̄êl mêṯ wə·hay·yā·ṯêḏ bə·raq·qā·ṯōw
verses.literal: When Barak arrived in pursuit of Sisera Jael went out to greet him and said to him Come and I will show you the man you are seeking So he went in with her and there lay Sisera dead with a tent peg through his temple
verses.literalPt: Eis que, seguindo Baraque a Sísera, saiu-lhe Jael ao encontro e disse-lhe: Vem, e mostrar-te-ei o homem a quem procuras. Entrou-lhe na tenda; e eis que Sísera jazia morto, e o prego estava encerrado na sua fonte.

verses.original: וַיַּכְנַ֤ע אֱלֹהִים֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אֵ֖ת יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָ֑עַן לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḵ·na‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’êṯ yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- kə·nā·‘an lip̄·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: On that day God subdued Jabin king of Canaan before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia, humilhou Deus a Jabim, rei de Canaã, diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַתֵּ֜לֶךְ יַ֤ד בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְקָשָׁ֔ה עַ֖ל יָבִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָ֑עַן עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְרִ֔יתוּ אֵ֖ת יָבִ֥ין מֶֽלֶךְ־ כְּנָֽעַן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·leḵ yaḏ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl hā·lō·wḵ wə·qā·šāh ‘al yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- kə·nā·‘an ‘aḏ ’ă·šer hiḵ·rî·ṯū ’êṯ yā·ḇîn me·leḵ- kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: And the hand of the Israelites grew stronger and stronger against Jabin king of Canaan until they destroyed him . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: A mão dos filhos de Israel prevalecia cada vez mais contra Jabim, rei de Canaã, até que de todo o destruíram.
